articles.title: Zerohash pursues new funding at more than $1.5 billion valuation after Mastercard drops investment plans
articles.snippet: Crypto infrastructure providers are drawing renewed investor interest as Wall Street deepens its push into digital assets.

articles.title: The SEC wants to let newly public companies raise cash instantly in its biggest rule change in decades
articles.snippet: The agency is proposing its largest overhaul of public listing rules in over 20 years, cutting compliance costs and giving crypto firms a much easier path to raise cash on Wall Street.

articles.title: Senator Elizabeth Warren accuses U.S. regulator of approving unqualified crypto banks
articles.snippet: The Senate Banking Committee's top Democrat sent a letter to the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency questioning the charters of nine crypto firms.

articles.title: JPMorgan says ether and altcoins won't catch up to bitcoin without a major network boom
articles.snippet: The bank said ether and the broader altcoin market continue to trail bitcoin as weak network activity, sluggish DeFi growth and limited real-world adoption weigh on investor demand.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: Bitcoin Cash (BCH) rises 2.1%
articles.snippet: NEAR Protocol (NEAR), up 2.8%, was also a top performer.
